**Calculation:**

⇒ Total marks by student Q in Physics and Hindi = 90% of 80 + 54% of 100

⇒ Total marks by student Q in Physics and Hindi = (90)/(100)times 80 + 54 = 72 + 54 = 126

⇒ Total marks by student T in Geography and History = 88% of 75 + 42% of 50

⇒ Total marks by student T in Geography and History = (88)/(100)times 75+(42)/(100)times 50 = 66 + 21 = 87

⇒ Increase in marks = 126 – 87 = 39

⇒ Percentage increase in marks = (39)/(87)times 100approx 45%

**Therefore, student Q obtained 45% more marks than student T in the respective subjects.**
